executable_actions.rationale: Resolve the tx0 CCTG contradiction before any current-layer code repair. The reconciliation must compare the failed start-before-ingress predicates against the live board lifecycle invariant and the closed connected-kernel certificate, classify the finding as an observer-contract conflict, preserve all active SACG barriers/retry requests, and request bounded human approval for any future testbench-only supersession. It produces no hardware-pass claim and neither reruns nor repairs the connected kernel.

observations: functional_sim is the sole executed failing current-layer functional gate. The dependent multilayer-functional, deadlock, AXI-protocol, DDR-roundtrip, and board-semantic-evidence gates are not_run due to its failure and must not be launched next.

The earliest CCTG records at cycle 20572946 show stage0/direct-core ingress transfer tx0 before lifecycle start at cycle 20572948. This conflicts with the live hash-validated policy accepted_input_handshake_required_before_kernel_lifecycle_start; therefore kernel_start_precedes_stage0_input and kernel_start_precedes_direct_core_ingress are observer-contract conflicts, not proven RTL faults.

The later no-egress observation is real but remains non-root-cause-specific: 1792 core-ingress beats were accepted while ready core egress accepted zero beats. It blocks board liveness, output count/order, numeric comparison, and DDR writeback claims, but cannot justify a kernel edit while the earliest lifecycle predicate is inconsistent.

The completed connected_kernel_cctg_contradiction_targeted_replay is closed, hash-bound lower-layer evidence: fresh VCS execution observed complete 1792-beat ingress and egress, terminal last, and boundary liveness pass. No new current trace contradicts a named certified invariant after this completion, so leaf and connected-kernel tools must not be requested, rerun, or repaired.

Exact user wrapper identity and source-closure hashes are bound and passed. The failing exact-sample testbench observability/schema and elaboration-report findings are verification-capability defects, not hardware correctness evidence; any observer correction must retain the exact wrapper, checkpoint, stimulus, target-model expected output, numeric policy, tolerance, and DUT weight-binding requirements.

Runtime-load progress of 1056/1056 words is not proof of contiguous address order, data/image equality, load-before-start, or complete board DUT weight consumption because dynamic runtime-loader acceptance evidence is invalid. No board target-model numeric comparison has executed.

sacg_memory_truth authoritatively reports 23 active same-scope contamination barriers and 8 open same-scope retry requests, with zero open same-scope backtracks. Rejected Stage7/Stage8 artifacts remain planning/debug evidence only and all barriers/retries remain downstream-consumption and promotion blockers until a new Stage7 pass.
proposed_actions: Create a hash-bound exact-board lifecycle CCTG reconciliation and human approval request only; do not alter the DUT, wrapper, weights, golden/reference, numeric comparison policy, tolerance, checkpoint, stimulus, or closed lower-layer replay.
risks: Changing input gating, block_input, kernel lifecycle logic, or the connected kernel to force start-before-ingress would contradict the live lifecycle invariant, can introduce deadlock, and would improperly reopen certified lower-layer evidence.

A lifecycle-predicate supersession changes a verification/testbench semantic contract. It requires bounded human approval and must not become a timing-policy relaxation, golden alteration, tolerance change, numeric-policy change, checkpoint/stimulus substitution, or user-wrapper modification.

After approved observer reconciliation, a corrected trace may still show no egress. That result must be localized to the next valid board integration, loader, lifecycle, data-order, or AXI/DDR boundary before any RTL repair; it is not pre-authorized evidence against the certified connected kernel.

The currently invalid dynamic observability, hierarchy, and loader evidence creates cross-layer risks across lifecycle, runtime memory addressing, data order, shape/count, and weight consumption. It cannot support a model-value or board functional pass.
Active contamination barriers and open retry requests prohibit promotion and downstream consumption of the failed artifacts. This action may record their preservation but cannot clear them.

Select only the next causally distinct action: reconcile the hash-bound exact-board lifecycle observer/CCTG contract and emit a bounded approval request. The tx0 start-before-ingress predicate conflicts with the live board invariant requiring an accepted input handshake before kernel lifecycle start, so it is not a legal block_input or kernel RTL root cause. Do not modify hardware or rerun the closed connected-kernel replay. No board functional, numeric, data-order, AXI, DDR-roundtrip, runtime-loader-consumption, or semantic-evidence pass exists; dependent board gates remain blocked.
